root_cause.text: The check_imm macro in the arm64 BPF JIT compiler uses a shift by `bits` instead of `bits - 1` when validating signed immediate ranges, causing an off-by-one error that allows branch displacements one bit too large for the intended signed N-bit field, potentially flipping branch direction.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description and commit message explain that the original macro `(imm > 0 && imm >> bits) || (imm < 0 && ~imm >> bits)` admits values in `[-2^N, 2^N)` — a signed (N+1)-bit range — while a signed N-bit field only holds `[-2^(N-1), 2^(N-1))`. The patch fixes this by shifting by `(bits - 1)` instead of `bits`.
